findings.title: Migration crashes when no embed category matches
findings.body: This indexes the first row of an inner join without checking whether the query returned anything. On installations where `embed_category` is unset, blank, or names a category that no longer exists, the result is empty and this raises before the migration can complete, blocking upgrades. Handle the missing match and fall back to the uncategorized category.

findings.title: Legacy allowed hosts are not migrated
findings.body: `cmd_tuples` reports rows affected by commands such as INSERT or UPDATE; for this SELECT it is zero, even when rows were returned. Consequently, the migration skips the host import and then deletes the legacy `embeddable_hosts` setting on line 31, losing the configured allowlist and disabling existing embeds. Check the result's row count instead.

findings.title: Configured hosts with ports never match
findings.body: The host validator accepts entries such as `example.com:8080`, but `URI#host` returns only `example.com`, so this query cannot match that stored entry. Conversely, an entry without a port matches requests on any port. Compare normalized authorities consistently or remove port support from validation if ports are intentionally ignored.
